fn index_of(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Int
  requires contains(xs, x)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result < len(xs)))
  ensures (xs[result] == x)
  ensures forall i in 0..result: (xs[i] != x)
  effects pure
  example (index_of([4, 7, 9], 7) == 1)
  example (index_of([3, 3, 3], 3) == 0)
  example (index_of([1, 2, 3, 2], 2) == 1)
  example (index_of([5], 5) == 0)
  example (index_of([1, 2, 3], 3) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then 0 else (1 + index_of(t, x)) }
}

fn longest_run(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) > 0)
  ensures ((result >= 1) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures exists i in 0..((len(xs) - result) + 1): forall j in i..(i + result): (xs[j] == xs[i])
  ensures not (exists i in 0..(len(xs) - result): forall j in i..((i + result) + 1): (xs[j] == xs[i]))
  effects pure
  example (longest_run([1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3]) == 3)
  example (longest_run([7]) == 1)
  example (longest_run([1, 2, 3]) == 1)
  example (longest_run([5, 5, 1, 5, 5, 5]) == 3)
  example (longest_run([2, 2, 2, 2]) == 4)
{
  match xs { [] => 1 [h, ..t] => compute_longest(t, h, 1, 1) }
}

fn compute_longest(xs: List[Int], current_elem: Int, current_len: Int, max_len: Int) -> Int
  requires (current_len >= 1)
  requires (max_len >= 1)
  ensures (result >= max_len)
  ensures (result >= current_len)
  ensures (result >= 1)
  effects pure
  example (compute_longest([], 1, 2, 2) == 2)
  example (compute_longest([3, 3], 1, 1, 1) == 2)
  example (compute_longest([2, 3], 1, 1, 1) == 1)
  example (compute_longest([2, 2, 3], 1, 1, 1) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => if (current_len > max_len) then current_len else max_len [h, ..t] => if (h == current_elem) then compute_longest(t, current_elem, (current_len + 1), max_len) else if (current_len > max_len) then compute_longest(t, h, 1, current_len) else compute_longest(t, h, 1, max_len) }
}

fn merge_sorted(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (sorted(xs) and sorted(ys))
  ensures sorted(result)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) + len(ys)))
  ensures forall x in xs: (count(result, x) == (count(xs, x) + count(ys, x)))
  ensures forall y in ys: (count(result, y) == (count(xs, y) + count(ys, y)))
  effects pure
  example (merge_sorted([1, 4, 9], [2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 9])
  example (merge_sorted([], [5, 6]) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([5, 6], []) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([], []) == [])
  example (merge_sorted([1, 2], [3, 4]) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
{
  match xs { [] => ys [hx, ..tx] => match ys { [] => xs [hy, ..ty] => if (hx <= hy) then ([hx] ++ merge_sorted(tx, ys)) else ([hy] ++ merge_sorted(xs, ty)) } }
}

  example (drop_n([1, 2, 3], 0) == [1, 2, 3])
  example (drop_n([], 0) == [])
{

  ensures (result == len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (size([]) == 0)
  example (size([5, 7, 9]) == 3)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [_, ..t] => (1 + size(t)) }
}

fn has(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Bool
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, v))
  effects pure
  example (has([1, 2, 3], 2) == true)
  example (has([1, 2, 3], 5) == false)
  example (has([], 1) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == v) or has(t, v)) }
}

fn greater_count(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures ((result == 0) == (forall x in xs: (x <= v)))
  effects pure
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 3) == 1)
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 9) == 0)
  example (greater_count([3, 9, 1], 0) == 3)
  example (greater_count([], 0) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h > v) then (1 + greater_count(t, v)) else greater_count(t, v) }
}

fn is_second(xs: List[Int], r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures ((not ((len(xs) < 2) and result)) or (r == None))
  ensures ((not ((len(xs) >= 2) and result)) or (r != None))
  effects pure
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(3)) == true)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], Some(9)) == false)
  example (is_second([3, 9, 1], None) == false)
  example (is_second([4], None) == true)
  example (is_second([4], Some(4)) == false)
  example (is_second([], None) == true)
{
  match r { None => (size(xs) < 2) Some(v) => (has(xs, v) and (greater_count(xs, v) == 1)) }
}

fn find_second_in_tail(xs: List[Int], tail: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires distinct(xs)
  requires distinct(tail)
  ensures match result { None => forall x in tail: (greater_count(xs, x) != 1) Some(v) => (has(tail, v) and (greater_count(xs, v) == 1)) }
  effects pure
  example (find_second_in_tail([9, 3, 1], [3, 1]) == Some(3))
  example (find_second_in_tail([9, 1], []) == None)
{
  match tail { [] => None [h, ..t] => if (greater_count(xs, h) == 1) then Some(h) else find_second_in_tail(xs, t) }
}

  requires distinct(xs)
